column3: MT 8:23. “The latter” is rendered “later on,” and NASB supplies “her who was” and “it.”
MT 9:1. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 9:2. “To it” is rendered “their,” following the Qere “to it” rather than the Ketiv “not.”
MT 9:3. “Like the day of Midian” is rendered “as at the battle of Midian.”
MT 9:4. “Every boot which marches with shaking” is rendered “every boot of the booted warrior in the battle tumult.”
MT 9:5. “Dominion” is rendered “the government,” and “a wonder, a counselor” as one title, “Wonderful Counselor.”
MT 9:6. “From now” is rendered “From then on.”
MT 9:7. “He has sent … it will fall” is rendered in the present, “sends … falls.”
MT 9:8. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 9:9. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 9:10. “Set on high” is rendered “raises,” and “against him” as “against them.”
MT 9:11. “With all the mouth” is rendered “with gaping jaws.”
MT 9:12. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 9:13. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 9:14. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 9:15. “Misleading … confused” is rendered “leading them astray … brought to confusion.”
MT 9:16. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 9:17. “A rising up of smoke” is rendered “a column of smoke.”
MT 9:18. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 9:19. “Devoured … ate” is rendered “slice off … eat.”
MT 9:20. NASB supplies “devours” and “are.”
